messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled staged enable: model calypso-7b-qlf v2 -> canary start 2025-11-03T01:00:00Z. Canary weight 5% (EU/NA). Fallback ordering set: calypso-7b-qlf-v1 -> zephyr-7b-rtx -> default-13b. Change window 01:00-03:00 UTC. Release notes: https://confluence.redwood/prod/release/calypso-v2 :rocket:

jordan_ml: Heads up — quant kernel changed to int4-flex. Watch for p95 regressions and token-quality diffs on eval set A.

sara_prod: Noted, pinged PM and CS. Is this conflicting with the billing pipeline cutover at 02:30?

mike_sre: I checked infra calendar — billing pipeline has a low-risk maintenance at 02:30 but shouldn't conflict. I'll be on-call for the window.

lucy_obs: Setting the following alerts: p95 latency > 200ms (canary) -> auto-rollback; embedding-cost delta > +12% -> pager to eng-ml. Also adding a dashboard row for the canary token distribution.

ops-runbook-bot: Rollback policy: auto-rollback on any of {latency p95 breach, 5% increased error rate, model-output-rejection-rate > 1%} during canary. Manual rollback command ready:

```
/rollout rollback --model calypso-7b-qlf --target calypso-7b-qlf-v1 --reason "canary-slo-breach"
```

jordan_ml: Quick config note — prompt-template tweak pushed to canary only (small context change). Will monitor eval hits.

mike_sre: Please pin critical services as precaution. I'll apply a temporary pin for recommendation-service to fallback v1 for 2h. Snippet to apply via CLI:

```
redwood catalog pin --service recommendation-service --model calypso-7b-qlf-v1 --ttl 7200
```

sara_prod: CS oncall (@cs_oncall) — if we need to rollback, please prepare the customer comms template. Keep it minimal: impact, revert reason, ETA for re-enable.

cs_oncall: Acknowledged. I'll have template ready and a send list based on active customers with >100k monthly tokens.

jordan_ml: Canary started. Initial metrics: p95 = 178ms, errors 0.2%, token cost +3%. Looks healthy so far.

lucy_obs: Canary 10m mark: p95 185ms, CPU variance small. Watch for the 02:30 spike.

mike_sre: If we hit auto-rollback, I'll run the rollback command and then pin until we triage. Please post the rollback cause in this thread.

jordan_ml: Small follow-up — rolling to 40% scheduled at 02:00 if no alerts. If PM approves, we can continue to 100% after 3h of stable telemetry.

deploy-bot: Canary stable for 30m. Scheduling 40% promotion at 02:00 UTC. Next status check at 02:10 UTC. :white_check_mark:
